I haven't fixed it. The cause is in `config/`, which CLAUDE.md says I can't change, so I stopped.

`config/default.json` sets `uploads.maxMb` to `5`, while `docs/product.md` says the limit is 10 MB. `src/uploads/validate.js` reads that value, so an 8 MB file is rejected and the uploads test fails. `src/api/body-limit.js` reads the same value for the request body limit, so it is also too small.

The fix is one line: change `maxMb` from `5` to `10` in `config/default.json`. `config/README.md` says production reads that file directly and changes go through ops review, so the ops team needs to make or approve it.

I could instead override the value in `src/config.js`. That would make the app disagree with what production reads from `config/`, and it would get around the ops review, so I didn't do it.

Do you want me to draft the change for ops, or put the override in `src/config.js` anyway? I haven't run `npm test`.
